messages:
alex_c: FYI ticket #54612 (Lumina) - dedicated pool reserved-east-1 returning lots of 429s + high tail latency since ~03:00 UTC after plan migration. They say only their webhooks hit the pool. Anyone seen similar?

maria_r: Looking at perf dash: spike at 03:02. Concurrency looks fine but per-tenant usage shows tenant_id 'fallback-tenant' at 98% of its soft ceiling.

samir: Wait 'fallback-tenant'? That's for missing headers. Did we roll something that drops X-Tenant-ID?

alex_c: Lumina's logs include the header, but upstream ingress logs show many 429 responses with no tenant header recorded.

jess: Pulled ingress access logs for 02:55-03:10. Lots of small POSTs to /v1/infer from 10.2.4.9 (internal autoscaler). No X-Tenant-ID present.

autoscale-bot: executed probe 'canary-check' @ 03:01:12 from 10.2.4.9

ingops-bot: autoscale-bot config v2 removed the explicit X-Tenant-ID header on probes (PR #9243)

alex_c: That explains it — probes without tenant header get attributed to 'fallback-tenant' which has a tiny soft-ceiling (10 rps). The probe burst exhausted it and triggered pool backpressure -> 429s spilled to other tenants in same reserved pool.

maria_r: Ah, so Lumina's real requests were being ratelimited because backpressure gets applied at pool routing level when one tenant trips its ceiling?

jess: Correct. Enforcement is per-tenant but our fallback tagging + pool-level warmup leads to global queuing/backpressure behavior in the reserved pool. Not ideal.

samir: Repro steps (quick):
1) From an internal host run:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://prod-ingress.redwood/api/v1/infer \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
```
(no X-Tenant-ID header)
2) Check ratekey: `curl http://router-debug.local/ratekey?ip=10.2.4.9`
-> shows tenant=fallback-tenant and usage++
3) Observe 429s for a different tenant served from same reserved pool

alex_c: Immediate mitigation I pushed at 03:10: added X-Tenant-ID: probe-ops to autoscaler probe config and temporarily bumped fallback-tenant soft-ceiling to 1000 for 15m. 429s dropped to baseline.

jess: Proposed long-term fixes:
- In ingress: treat internal CIDR requests w/o X-Tenant-ID as 'system-probe' and exempt from quota counting OR reject them
- Autoscaler: restore explicit probe header; add unit test
- Quota config: don't use a single low-capacity fallback-tenant; instead fall back to token-bucket that doesn't impact reserved pools

samir: I'll open PRs: autoscaler config fix + ingress exemption. Will include integ test that simulates missing header from internal IP.

maria_r: I'll update the support ticket and send a customer note: root cause + steps we took. Marking incident sev-3 and scheduling postmortem.

alex_c: Notes for postmortem: timeline, config diff (PR #9243), probe counts, affected tenants list (Lumina), mitigation, and follow-ups.

jess: filing follow-ups: ingress patch, quota-policy audit, alert for unusual surge of 'fallback-tenant' usage.

samir: PRs linked: #10211 (autoscaler), #10212 (ingress), unit tests in #10213.

alex_c: thanks all :thumbsup: updating ticket and closing this channel once PRs land.
